decisions.claim: B has Chinese and English language skills/abilities
decisions.reason: A's use of definite possessive 'your Chinese and English' in turn 1 presupposes B has these language skills/abilities.

decisions.claim: B has Chinese and English language abilities
decisions.reason: Semantically identical to c1: 'language abilities' and 'language skills/abilities' are equivalent, same evidence, same mechanism.

decisions.claim: B is pursuing a translator position at A's company
decisions.reason: 'if you succeed in becoming a translator in our company' presupposes B is attempting/pursuing that role; the conditional about succeeding implies an ongoing effort.
